blocks.text: 53 3030 TRETHEWEY STREET Abbotsford West Abbotsford V2T 4N2

parts.t: Welcome to CLEARBROOK VILLAGE! This stunning south-facing townhome offers a spacious 1160 square feet of living space with 3 beds and 2 baths. The interior has been thoughtfully renovated, featuring upgraded flooring, fresh paint, and newer appliances. Located near the City Centre, shopping centres, schools, library, public transport, and the Rotary Stadium. The strata updates include new windows, doors, siding, roof carports, gutters, and insulation. Enjoy the privacy of a fenced backyard, perfect for outdoor relaxation, and benefit from the added convenience of the unit backing onto a playground, ideal for families with children.
